title: Minimal finite U(1) effective-gauge hybrid of the hash-pinned A1 F_ref candidate
scientific_role: Freeze one explicit finite-regulator model and test HYB-00 through HYB-04 before any A13 crosswalk.

finite_regulator.field: Psi in C^3 at every site, represented as a gauge-singlet matter field
finite_regulator.representation: trivial one-dimensional representation on Psi; explicit and not silently promoted to a charged representation
finite_regulator.links: U_{x,mu} in U(1) on every oriented link
finite_regulator.tect_parent: F_ref from the hash-pinned standalone A1 backend at eta_shell=0 on the declared N=(2,2,2) spectral regulator
finite_regulator.interaction: S_int=kappa sum_{x,p attached to x} rho_x (1-Re U_p), rho_x=Psi_x^dagger Psi_x

parent_reductions.tect_gauge_off: At U=1 every plaquette defect and S_YM vanish, so S_hyb(1,Psi)=F_ref(Psi) exactly.
parent_reductions.effective_gauge_frozen_psi: At Psi=0, F_ref and S_int vanish, so S_hyb(U,0)=S_YM^U1(U) exactly.
parent_reductions.yang_mills_scope: The frozen parent is an explicitly declared regulated U(1) effective gauge model, not four-dimensional pure Yang-Mills.
parent_reductions.canonical_spectral_boundary: The finite N=(2,2,2) regulator is exact for the declared F_ref parent only; no continuum or regulator-removal identification is asserted.

gauge_contract.transformation: g_x in U(1), Psi_x unchanged, U_{x,mu} -> g_x U_{x,mu} conjugate(g_{x+mu})
gauge_contract.ward_identity: The finite action is constant on every local gauge orbit; the orbit derivative is the Euclidean Gauss/Ward constraint.

stability_contract.classii_form: The A1 F_ref Class-II quadratic form is nonnegative because a>0 and a*c-b^2>0.
stability_contract.local_potential: lambda*rho^2/4+gamma*rho^3/6 >= lambda^3/(12*gamma^2) for rho>=0 with lambda<0<gamma.

finite_dynamics.generator: L f=-grad(S_hyb).grad(f)+beta_inverse*Delta(f) on finite matter coordinates and periodic link angles
finite_dynamics.detailed_balance: formal finite-dimensional Gibbs residual is zero
finite_dynamics.time_separation: stochastic quantization time, Euclidean transfer time, and physical real time are distinct

hostile_mutations: replace trivial representation by a charged representation while retaining the ungauged spectral F_ref term
replace F_ref by the mismatched F_decl functional
set gamma nonpositive or beta_g negative
identify stochastic time with physical real time
promote finite U(1) detailed balance to OS/KMS, Yang-Mills, A13 or continuum closure
mark the R-192 missing owner slots as present without hash-pinned evidence

selection.HYB-05: NOT-ATTEMPTED; R-192 first missing slot remains heat_root_incidence
selection.HYB-06: OPEN; no physical Hilbert-space or gauge/TECT current bridge
selection.candidate_verdict: RETAIN AS AN EXPLICIT FINITE EFFECTIVE-GAUGE COMPARISON; DO NOT SELECT AS THE CANONICAL TECT PRODUCTION OWNER

boundary: This T0 package proves only the finite contract audit for one explicit U(1) effective-gauge model. It is not a pure Yang-Mills theorem, does not construct a physical Hilbert space, does not supply R-192 heat-root incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner or one-use q-ledger, and does not close A13, T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, OS/KMS, real-time, thermodynamic, continuum or mass-gap obligations.
